question: I am trying to change the order of the items within a CMS collection on my Wix site, but the provided steps did not work for me.
answer:
To change the order of items within a CMS (Content Management System) collection on your Wix site, you can try the following steps:

1. Click Sort at the top of your collection.
2. Click + Add a Sort.
3. Select the field you want to sort by under "Select the order".
4. Choose a sorting option (e.g., A-Z, Low-High, Oldest-Newest).
5. If desired, mirror the item order to your live site's connected elements.

If these steps don't work for you, it's possible that there are specific options or settings required for your CMS collection on Wix. You may want to check the Wix documentation or contact their support team for further assistance.

question: I cant access my old email address to change my password. I have a recovery phone number added to my Wix account.
answer:
If you've forgotten the original email address of your Wix account, you can recover it by following these steps:

1. Go to the Wix Account Recovery page and enter your website URL.
2. Enter up to 3 possible email addresses you may have used and click Next.
3. Select Send me a code to my phone number ending with XXXX and click Next.
4. Enter the one-time verification code sent to your phone under "Enter code here".
5. Click Verify.
6. After verifying, enter a new password and retype it.

If you're unable to recover your account using these steps, you can try to find the email address again using the Wix email locator tool or by filling out the Wix Account Recovery form.

Note that any changes you make to your default working hours will not affect staff members' custom working hours, but changing them will override their current settings.

question: Can you help me understand how to enable guest checkout for my pricing plans on Wix?
answer:
To enable guest checkout for PayPal on Wix, follow these steps:

1. Sign in to your PayPal account.
2. Click the Settings icon (gear) on the right.
3. Click the Seller Tools tab.
4. Click Update next to Website Preferences.
5. Scroll down and select On under PayPal Account Optional.

Alternatively, you can also enable guest checkout for Standard or Fast Checkout in Wix Stores:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap Manage at the bottom.
3. Tap Subscriptions under Sales.
4. Select "Guest Checkout" from the dropdown menu.
5. Choose Standard or Fast Checkout (depending on your store settings).

If you're unable to see this setting in your PayPal account, please contact your local PayPal organization and ask them to enable it for you.

Please note that if a customer is not able to use guest checkout, it may be due to one of the following reasons:

* Incorrect email address or PayPal credentials
* Insufficient payment information (e.g., debit card details)
* Payment restrictions in their PayPal account

question: How can I set up an automation for a clients birthday to send an email offering a free class?

1. Create a new automation from the dashboard.

3. In the "Actions" section, click on "Emails & SMS notifications".
4. Select "Bookings" as the email notification type and choose "Confirmation and Cancelation email automations only".
5. Set up your email to include a Universal Calendar File format with details about the booking.
6. Add a condition to trigger when the contact's birthday is approaching (e.g., within the next 30 days).
7. Choose an action to send the automated email, such as a welcome message or a reminder about your free class offer.

This will create an automation that sends an email offering your client a free class on their birthday, based on the conditions you set up.

2. Click Connect next to Wix Payments or See More Payment Options beside Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers (if you don't see your preferred provider).
3. Select the new payment provider and click Yes, Switch to confirm your new provider.

Alternatively, if you have an existing account connected to a third-party payment provider like Stripe or PayPal, you can:

1. Check which provider you currently have connected to your Wix site.
2. View your current credentials before switching.

You can then switch to a different account with the same payment provider if available in your region.

question: How can I use the Toolbar and Layers Panel in the Wix Editor to adjust the positioning of my images?
answer:
You can use the toolbar and layers panel to adjust the positioning of your images. Specifically, you can:

* Use the right-click feature to move an image forward, backward, or bring it to the front or send it to the back.
* Right-click an image in a grid gallery and select "Arrange" from the context menu.

This will allow you to rearrange the order of your images in the grid gallery.

question: I need help adding a button with a link in the Wix Editor.
answer:
You need help setting up a button that has a link in the Wix Editor. To do this, follow these steps:

1. Click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click Button and drag a button onto the page.
3. Click the button and select the Link icon.
4. Select Page on the left dropdown menu under When image is clicked.
5. Select Product Page from the Which page? drop-down menu.
6. Enter the link details in the specified fields.

Additionally, you can also add links to buttons by following these steps:

1. Click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click Button and drag a button onto the page.
3. Click the button and select the Link icon.
4. Select a link type (e.g. Link, URL).
5. Enter the relevant link information in the specified fields.

If you need further assistance or have any questions, feel free to ask!

7. Since you have multiple options with different prices, repeat steps 3-6 for each of the three options and the base price.

When creating a new website on Wix and purchasing a domain from Wix, you need to add two DNS records: A (Address) record and CNAME record. The A record maps the domain name to an IP address of your web host, while the CNAME record points to the domain name.

Here's how to do it:

1. Log in to your Wix account.
2. Go to Domain Settings > Domains.
3. Select your existing domain and click on the "Connect" button.
4. In the Connect to a new domain window, select the domain you want to connect (e.g., `www.example.com`).
5. Click "Add record".
6. Add the A record by selecting "DNS settings" > "Records" and adding an A record for your domain name.
7. Set the DNS server to your web host's servers.

For the CNAME record, you'll need to specify the following:

* The hostname (e.g., `www.example.com`) associated with your Wix domain.
* The IP address of your web host.
* An alias for the existing primary domain (if different from the one you want to connect).

If you're unsure about any step or have questions, feel free to ask, and I'll do my best to assist you.

answer:

7. Corners: Enter a value in px for specific corners (e.g., top-left, bottom-right).
8. Text: Change the font size and style using the text field.

Now, you need to adjust the layout of the search bar to display it as a description box. You can do this by:

1. Going back to your page's Design tab.
2. Selecting the Search Results element again.
3. Click on Layouts icon (located under "Customize" button).
4. In the available layouts, choose "Description" layout.

This will display the search bar as a box below the input field instead of a rectangular tile.

question: What's the difference between 'site sessions' and 'unique visitors'?
answer:
The difference between 'site sessions' and 'unique visitors' is as follows:

- Site Sessions: A session starts when a visitor reaches your site, ends after 30 minutes of inactivity, and can have multiple page views and actions performed by the same visitor. Each time a new session is started, it's counted in traffic data.
- Unique Visitors: A unique visitor is defined as an email recipient who interacts with your site after viewing your campaign email. This means that a person's actions can only be counted once, even if they visit your site multiple times.

In other words, 'site sessions' are related to how many times a visitor views your site, while 'unique visitors' are the individuals themselves.

2. Copy the DNS records of the domain and paste them into a separate document or a different part of your Wix account.
3. Go to Domains in your Wix account and select the domain Actions icon next to it, then choose Manage DNS records.
4. Click "Assign" and select a site from your Wix account.
